device.description: dual 12-bit voltage-output DAC with 16-bit serial interface (SPI), double-buffered DAC B, speed and power-down program bits
device.note: slas156g.pdf (SLAS156G) p.1 (pinouts: D, P, JG 8-pin; FK 20-pin), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 4.5-5.5 V), p.7 (digital input timing, Figure 1), p.12 (power-on reset to 0), p.14-15 (serial interface, Figure 18 word format, Table 2 program bits, latch transfers Figures 19-21)

registers.name: LATCHA
registers.note: latch A (DAC A); written directly by a D15 = 1 word (p.14); reset to all 0s at power up (p.12)

registers.name: DBUF
registers.note: double buffer latch, the input register of DAC B (p.14-15); reset 0 at power up

registers.name: LATCHB
registers.note: latch B (DAC B); loaded from the serial word (D15 = 0, D12 = 0) or from the double buffer (D15 = 1)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: program bits D14 (1 = fast, 2.5 us settling) and D13 (1 = power down) of the last word (Table 2 p.14); power-on value not given (0)

commands.name: Latch A write, latch B update (D15 = 1)
commands.note: SIR data to latch A, double buffer to latch B, at CS rising (p.14, Figure 19)

commands.name: Latch B and double-buffer write (D15 = 0, D12 = 0)
commands.note: SIR data to latch B and the double buffer; latch A unaffected (p.15, Figure 20)

commands.name: Double-buffer-only write (D15 = 0, D12 = 1)
commands.note: SIR data to the double buffer only; latches A and B unaffected (p.15, Figure 21)

protocol.note: DIN shifted into the 16-bit SIR on SCLK falling edges while CS is low (SCLK high at CS falling, Figure 1 -> mode 2); D15-D12 program bits then D11-D0 data, MSB first; the transfer happens at CS rising (p.14)

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (ROC), p.7 (timing, Figure 1), p.12 (power-on reset), p.14-15 (serial interface, Table 2, Figures 18-21)
notModeled: analog: voltage outputs OUT A/OUT B, reference input REFIN (x2 output gain)
D14 speed (12.5 us / 2.5 us settling) and D13 power down are stored in the internal CTRL register only; power down affects only the analog outputs
a frame with other than 16 SCLK falling edges: the datasheet requires SCLK high after the 16th falling edge (Figure 1 note A); the model takes the first 16 bits and transfers at CS rising
DAC A has no double buffer: its input and DAC register are the same latch (dac lists LATCHA twice); a D15 = 1 word copies the double buffer to latch B with updateall
variants: TLC5618A (the orderable parts here: TLC5618AQD, 5962-99557 = TLC5618AM in JG/FK) and TLC5618 share this datasheet with the same pinout and interface; C/I/Q/M are temperature grades
